about: S-132 help triage eval: a customer's 'something's wrong' text → case category (HelpTriageEval). Precision and recall per category, safety recall must be 1.0, the summary must not decide anything (mustNotInclude: approve, refunded, we will refund) and must not carry contact details. `input` is the report text.

cases.input: Only one of the two wiper blades I ordered was in the bag.

json.summary: One of two wiper blades in the order was missing; the customer wants the missing blade.

cases.input: I got the 18 inch blades but ordered 22 inch.

json.summary: The customer received 18-inch blades instead of the 22-inch ones ordered.

cases.input: The soup container was crushed and leaking all over the bag.

json.summary: The soup arrived crushed and leaking.

cases.input: The plumber never showed up and didn't answer messages.

json.summary: The provider did not arrive for the booking and did not answer messages.

cases.input: After the brake job the car pulls left and squeals worse than before.

json.summary: After the brake job the car pulls left and squeals more than before.

cases.input: My daughter got sick after eating the shrimp, we went to the ER.

json.summary: The customer's daughter became ill after eating the shrimp and was taken to the emergency room.

cases.input: The worker yelled at me and threatened me when I asked about the price.

json.summary: The customer reports the provider shouted and made threats when asked about the price.

cases.input: I was charged twice for the same order, call me at 403-555-0199.

json.summary: The customer reports being charged twice for the same order.
